command: $root=31588; $all=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process; $ids=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[int]; [void]$ids.Add($root); $changed=$true; while($changed){$changed=$false; foreach($p in $all){if($ids.Contains([int]$p.ParentProcessId) -and -not $ids.Contains([int]$p.ProcessId)){[void]$ids.Add([int]$p.ProcessId);$changed=$true}}}; $rows=@(foreach($id in $ids){$c=$all|Where-Object ProcessId -eq $id; if($c){$gp=Get-Process -Id $id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [pscustomobject]@{PID=$id;PPID=$c.ParentProcessId;Name=$c.Name;MainWindowHandle=if($gp){$gp.MainWindowHandle}else{0};MainWindowTitle=if($gp){$gp.MainWindowTitle}else{''};CommandLine=$c.CommandLine}}}); $rows | Format-List
